TS11 · 10:07–10:12 AM · APPROVED

Chairman's Second Visit

Soniya and Mahendra · mutual teasing, permission-based brief contact, next-meeting hook

APPROVED
<div class="a02-prose">
Soniya ne abhi documents side mein rakhe hi the ki doorbell phir baj gayi.
Soniya: “Ab kaun? Aaj sach mein inspection day hai kya?”
Darwaza khola toh Mahendra Suri khade the.
Soniya: “Arre Chairman sahab! Subah gym mein milkar mann nahi bhara?”
Mahendra ek pal ke liye chup reh gaye.
Mahendra: “Fitness event ka registration form dena tha.”
Soniya: “Form WhatsApp par bhi aa sakta tha.”
Mahendra: “Haan, woh toh hai.”
Soniya: “Toh sach bataiye, form bahana hai ya mujhse milna tha?”
Mahendra muskura diye.
Mahendra: “Tum bhi na, har baat pakad leti ho.”
Soniya ne darwaza khol diya.
Soniya: “Aaiye. Lekin aaj aapki examination main lungi.”
10:09 AM.
Dining table ke paas Mahendra form rakhne lage. Soniya unke saamne khadi thi.
Soniya: “Gym mein aapne kaha tha ki main confident lag rahi hoon.”
Mahendra: “Haan. Woh sach tha.”
Soniya: “Aur ab?”
Mahendra: “Ab bhi wahi kahunga.”
Soniya thoda paas aayi.
Soniya: “Aap bade cautious hain.”
Mahendra: “Chairman hoon. Soch-samajhkar bolna padta hai.”
Soniya: “Lekin har baat bolkar hi thodi samjhani padti hai.”
Mahendra ne uski taraf dekha.
Mahendra: “Tum mujhe tease kar rahi ho?”
Soniya: “Bilkul. Aur aapko pata bhi hai.”
Soniya ne unka haath apne haath mein liya.
Soniya: “Relax, Mahendra ji. Aap itna nervous kyun hain?”
Mahendra: “Tumhare saamne jawab dena mushkil ho jaata hai.”
Soniya: “Phir toh aapko mere saath aur practice karni chahiye.”
Mahendra ne uski permission se ek pal uski kamar par haath rakha. Soniya ne nazar milaye rakhi, phir muskurate hue khud distance bana li.
Soniya: “Bas. Aaj ke liye itna confidence training enough hai.”
Mahendra: “Aur agla lesson?”
Soniya: “Woh main decide karungi. Aapko invitation milega toh pata chal jayega.”
10:11 AM.
Mahendra ki nazar hallway ke utility corner ki taraf gayi. Wahan ab bhi kuch gym clothes aur towels pade the.
Soniya ne notice kiya ki unka dhyaan bhatak gaya hai.
Soniya: “Chairman sahab, aaj aapki attention kitni baar divert hogi?”
Mahendra: “Tumhare ghar mein toh har cheez par sawaal hota hai.”
Soniya: “Sawaal nahi. Boundaries. Dono mein farq hai.”
Mahendra ne unki taraf dobara dekha.
Mahendra: “Tum mujhe phir kab milogi?”
Soniya: “Society meeting mein toh mil hi lenge. Private appointment ka decision baad mein.”
10:12 AM.
Committee appointment ka reminder Mahendra ke phone par aa gaya.
Mahendra: “Mujhe jaana padega.”
Soniya: “Toh jaiye. Warna Chairman sahab khud late mark ho jayenge.”
Darwaze par Soniya ne ek aakhri smile di.
Soniya: “Aur haan—agli baar form se zyada interesting conversation lekar aana.”
Mahendra chale gaye.
Soniya ne darwaza band kiya. Uske chehre par ab bhi muskurahat thi. Usne Rahul ki chat kholi aur ek private, flirtatious selfie ke saath message likha:
Soniya: “Aaj tumhari bahut yaad aa rahi hai. Free hote hi call karna. ❤️”
Phone side mein rakhkar woh apne kaam mein lag gayi.
TS11 — Scene end.
</article>
